ops.text: cc-context:ci-triage could not read a failed job's log while the run was still in progress, and plain 'gh api repos/<r>/actions/jobs/<id>/logs' returns only 'the response contains terminal escape sequences; pass --allow-escape-sequences'. Per-job logs ARE available mid-run with 'gh api --allow-escape-sequences ... | sed strip ANSI'; the triage agent should use that path instead of waiting for the whole run (lr-go takes ~7 min). Also: long-running CI's pull_request jobs never start on a CONFLICTING PR, and ccx vcs ship reports only 'no CI run was registered' without naming the conflict.
